about: A value beside a shape (the value wins), a triangle with no width, and a uniform with the wrong parameter names.

files.model.yaml:
model: tiny
title: value and shape
currency: USD

nodes:

  request_rate:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: request/second
    value: 200
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the busy hour, as stated for this case"}

  service_demand:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: core*second/request
    value: 0.02
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "processor time per request, as stated for this case"}

  cores:
    kind: input
    decided: you
    unit: core
    value: 16
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the fleet chosen for this case"}

  busy_cores:
    kind: derived
    unit: core
    formula: request_rate * service_demand

  utilisation:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: busy_cores / cores

  stored:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: TB
    value: 15
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "what is held, as stated for this case"}

  index:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: GB
    value: 500
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the index, as stated for this case"}

  disk_per_host:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: TB/host
    value: 2
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the disk each host has, as stated for this case"}

  both:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: TB
    value: 7
    distribution: {triangular: {minimum: 1.0, likely: 5.0, maximum: 9.0}}
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "triangular, and a value that wins at the point"}

  flat:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: TB
    distribution: {triangular: {minimum: 4.0, likely: 4.0, maximum: 4.0}}
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "triangular with no width"}

  wrong_parameters:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: TB
    distribution: {uniform: {low: 1.0, high: 2.0}}
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "uniform, with the wrong parameter names"}

  total:
    kind: derived
    unit: TB
    formula: both + flat + wrong_parameters

outputs:
  - utilisation
  - total
  - index
  - disk_per_host
  - stored
